headlines.title: Costco (COST) Declares $30 Special Dividend And Reauthorizes $4 Billion Buyback
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) declared a special cash dividend of $30 per share on common stock. The retailer also reauthorized a $4b share repurchase program with an expiration date in January 2030. The one time $30 special dividend and long dated buyback plan matter, but they are only part of the Costco picture. Our analysis turns up 1 warning sign for Costco Wholesale as well.

headlines.title: Costco Just Sent Shareholders a $13 Billion Signal It Has More Cash Than It Can Use. Here’s What 200 Shares Collect
headlines.summary: Costco declared a $30 a share special cash dividend after Tuesday's close, about $13.3 billion in all and the largest in its history, payable December 4 to holders of record November 24, plus a new $4 billion buyback. For a retired couple with 200 shares bought in 2010 that is a $6,000 check: here is the tax on it in a brokerage account, an IRA and a Roth, what the stock does on the ex-date, and the one decision the check forces.

headlines.summary: Costco's $13.3 billion special dividend lifted investor sentiment around the stock.

headlines.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation Declares $30 Special Cash Dividend and Reauthorizes Stock Repurchase Program
headlines.summary: ISSAQUAH, Wash., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Costco Wholesale Corporation (“Costco” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: COST) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a special cash dividend of $30 per share on Costco common stock. It is payable December 4, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 24, 2026. The total amount of the payment will be approximately $13.3 billion.

description: Costco Wholesale Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of membership warehouses in the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Sweden, Iceland, and New Zealand. It offers merchandise, including sundries, dry groceries, candies, coolers, freezers, liquor, and tobacco; non-food merchandise comprising consumer electronics, appliances, small electrics, health and beauty aids, hardware, lawn and garden, sporting goods, tires, toys and seasonal, automotive, stamps, tickets, apparel, furniture, domestics, housewares, special order kiosks, and jewelry; and fresh food, such as meat, produce, deli, and bakery products. The company is also involved in warehouse ancillary operations, which include gasoline, pharmacies, food courts, optical, hearing aids, and tire installation centers. In addition, it engages in e-commerce, business centers, travel, and other businesses. Further, the company operates e-commerce sites; and offers branded and private-label products in various categories. The company was formerly known as Costco Companies, Inc. and changed its name to Costco Wholesale Corporation in August 1999. Costco Wholesale Corporation was founded in 1976 and is based in Issaquah, Washington.
